title.ja: WebP 画像の準備

explanation: Pillow opens each source as RGBA, writes WebP with lossless=True and exact=True, reopens it and asserts identical dimensions, alpha bytes and visible RGB. SHA-256 names let identical source files share an output. This reduces duplicates without deliberately changing the approved pixels. These checks do not establish anatomical consistency or document which drawing tool produced every original.

title.ja: ポーズ間の体型を保つ

explanation: projectFrame selects the lifecycle, travel, attention or reaction frame, then calculates one scale and a foot anchor. Airborne sheets have registration corrections; the same scale drives width and height. This keeps sprite proportions instead of independently squeezing axes. It cannot fix inconsistencies already drawn into a frame.

title.ja: 飛行経路の開始

explanation: beginRoute copies the current visible foot and destination into a route. Ordinary duration is distance divided by 0.15, clamped to 1000–4000 milliseconds. Explicit call routes can supply a distance-based duration up to 18000 milliseconds so distant calls take longer. Copying the current start avoids teleporting back to an old perch.

title.ja: 経路に沿った移動

explanation: step advances the motion graph and route with elapsed time. On entry to flight it aligns the wing drawing clock with the graph's frame and elapsed time, avoiding a repeated out-of-phase downstroke at takeoff or landing. The smooth polynomial eases position between route endpoints. Arrival either holds flight as a hover or requests landing. update subdivides input time into at most 10-millisecond steps, limiting differences at state joins on different frame rates. This is timed 2D travel, not physics simulation or new generated drawings.

title.ja: 待機中の独立した周期

explanation: IdleMotion.pose supplies a 3800-ms cosine breathing cycle, 10400-ms sway and 6200-ms tail wave with a small arm delay. Its level fades acting in or out, rather than snapping. Blink waits vary between 4500 and 8000 ms and use designated existing eye frames. Different clocks avoid all small motions moving in lockstep.

title.ja: 基準の絵に小さな動きをつける

explanation: deformIdlePoint shifts existing image coordinates with smooth spatial weights for chest, belly, paws, wings and outer tail. Coordinates at or below source y=574 stay fixed, keeping the feet planted. The upper head/glasses share a rigid translation. It is a restrained image deformation, not a skeleton or a full redraw, and is used for idle only.

title.ja: 羽ばたきごとに繰り返さないまばたき

explanation: The countdown varies from 4200 to 8000 ms. Once it expires, update waits for wing phase 7 before using the matching closed-eye drawing; it reopens outside that phase. Thus timing is independent of each wing loop, but the actual blink is phase-gated to avoid a mismatched wing pose. Emotional drawings with closed eyes are separate.

title.en: Sleeping breath and the nose bubble
title.ja: 睡眠の呼吸と鼻の泡

explanation: The bubble is present only during sleep. The breath period is the sum of the sleep-frame durations; age modulo that period feeds a cosine from zero to one. Radius is 7 + 18 times that breath value, and the renderer scales it with the character and anchors it at frame.nose. This synchronizes the bubble with the sleep cycle; it does not model real respiratory volume.

title.ja: 読む速さに合わせた表情

explanation: cleanReplyBeats accepts two to four ordered sentence indices, validates allowed emotions/gestures, and requires index zero first. expressionSequence associates each beat with its text; beatPause clamps reading time between 3.2 and 12 seconds using character count and language. Existing full clips play instead of splicing isolated hands or mouths. There is no voice audio or phoneme lip-sync.

title.ja: 確認できる指さし先

explanation: guideTarget accepts only safe same-site URLs found in the published catalog, matches the selected language, then resolves a known section anchor. An invalid same-language anchor returns null instead of pointing to a guessed item. Navigation authority is this catalog, not an arbitrary selector or URL supplied by the model. The adjacent guideReplyMatches guard requires an arrival reply to name that target and rejects names of unrelated indexed pages absent from its supporting description; this is a title-consistency check, not general fact verification.

title.ja: ページをまたぐ案内

explanation: GuideJourney stores target, expected next page, origin, completed stop count and timestamp in tab storage with a 30-minute lifetime. enter distinguishes arrival, continuation, resuming and a detour. claimStep persists the last spoken stage so repeated callbacks, reloads or language switches do not count the same stop twice. progress combines completed stops with the remaining real route; no artificial steps are added. depart stores viewport coordinates; position scales them for a resized viewport when Yuki is already on that page. A guided page change uses her physical location and the normal timed magical summon from the previous page's header category, flying directly to the next guided perch. Guidance starts from a clear visitor request, with conversational clarification only for ambiguous destinations. The introduction names the destination and may express interest without explaining it. Every intermediate stop, including the penultimate one, gives only a precise Next/Then direction locally without model inference. Arrival requests the full grounded AI explanation in Yuki's own words with personal thoughts. Finally or 最後に is added only at arrival after more than three actual stops. The backend follows the same pacing and preserves it during prose repairs. Invalid, repeated or unavailable AI replies use one friendly local direction or arrival line, without quoting page descriptions. Route memory is separate from physical location memory.

title.ja: 範囲を限った会話の記憶

explanation: ConversationMemory retains up to 40 bounded question/answer pairs in the provided same-tab storage, with a 24-hour inactivity lifetime. recall ranks token overlap and prioritizes the same fact/joke activity for requests such as another one. It removes answers already in recent history but retains different older discovery answers even when their questions repeat, returning up to four exchanges. A keyword filter skips obvious credentials/contact strings but is not a complete sensitive-data detector. Clearing the transcript is separate from this store; this is not server-side personal memory.

title.ja: 言語を変えても元の意味を保つ

explanation: Each message keeps original text and separately stored translations. translatedText returns valid wording in the requested display language; stale assistant translations or formal Japanese originals wait for a checked tone-refreshed variant. User tone and direct quotations remain separate from Yuki's casual narration. translationBatch prioritizes recent messages within size caps. applyTranslations matches checked IDs and stores a display variant without overwriting the original. Both speakers' translations are checked for wrong-language prose. Authored bilingual greetings bypass model translation. The worker uses a fixed Cloudflare-hosted Gemma translation model with thinking disabled; it also handles Japanese focused follow-ups, Japanese jokes and voice repairs. English focused follow-ups and jokes use Nemotron, while the default conversation route uses Qwen. Translation shares verification and free quota, permits at most one reserved repair, and preserves already-correct items when only some need tone repair. These automated checks cannot guarantee naturalness or meaning, so translation quality still needs review.

title.ja: 返答の根拠を選ぶ

explanation: retrieveKnowledge filters the public catalog to the requested language and safe site paths. A validated guided event takes an early route-only path: it selects the final destination's overview and exact section, without old conversation, previously pointed images or making-of material. Other questions split long sections into overlapping passages and select at most six. An explicitly named page, resolved picture or current-page question limits evidence to that page. Current-page questions ignore stale history for ranking, omit an old guided target, and do not infer a making-of topic from prior conversation. Five published garden landmarks have their own source anchors; a nearby perch can select its evidence without claiming eye tracking. Natural whole-place questions instead reserve the page overview and a spread of its landmark or section descriptions, suppress the perch hint and making-of history, and explain the whole setting. Ordinary follow-ups can still use recent history and the guide reference. Broader questions search across the catalog. Curated making-of notes are separate; this is local text ranking, not live repository browsing or visual perception.

title.ja: 生成された返答の検証

explanation: parseModel extracts and parses the structured model answer, validates emotion, gesture, destination and text length, and resolves source IDs only against supplied page or web entries. For a server-resolved local page explanation, the smaller text-and-sources envelope receives a fixed speaking gesture and no navigation; ordinary routes still require their control fields. Exact inline citation markers and trailing sourceId labels for verified IDs are removed from prose while their real links are retained. A bounded intent label can route unfamiliar discovery or humor requests; it is not evidence or permission to bypass search budgets. Only the server can mark a delivered joke, assign a remembered discovery-topic ID or identify a resolved page overview. Bounded joke premise/payoff summaries are novelty hints, not factual evidence or a guarantee of humor. validReply also checks the prose: cleanAssistantText removes an unmistakably duplicated serialized text tail or a recognized nested reply envelope, and rejects ambiguous dangling response fields. Repaired wording discards stale expression indices. The display repeats this check for saved replies; user messages are not rewritten. Unsupported references are not converted into invented links. These structural safeguards do not prove every natural-language claim true. Requests still need verification, usage budget and evidence.

title.ja: 途中で切れた返答を整える

explanation: completionRequest prepares a short text-only rewrite using the draft, its cited evidence and relevant character lore. A focused speaker/voice edit can use the existing translation model to keep Yuki in first person and natural Japanese without changing the supported explanation. It does not replace names or pronouns blindly. Its humor-specific path preserves the fictional scene, setup and payoff rather than inflating a joke into an explanation. parseCompletion rejects malformed, unfinished or overlong results, retains the original sources and routing metadata, and removes old sentence-animation indices. The worker may use this instead of the variety rewrite, at most once within the existing quota and deadline; it is not an unlimited retry or a new web search. If repair cannot finish safely, incompleteAnswer gives a localized retry notice rather than a fragment. These checks do not prove that every claim is accurate.

title.ja: 明らかな返答の途切れを検出する

explanation: unfinishedReply checks for unfinished code fences, dangling English connectors and selected Japanese clause endings, as well as long prose without a sentence ending. It allows short labels, balanced code blocks, complete JSON examples and ordinary list items. Both the worker and the display use this conservative format check, including for saved assistant replies; visitor messages are not rewritten. It cannot establish grammatical or factual completeness, and never fabricates an ending by appending punctuation or truncating text.

title.ja: 背景の目印に足元を合わせる

explanation: gardenSpots stores hand-authored normalized coordinates for five perches, shared with location memory and the camera. gardenPoint converts them using the rendered illustration rectangle and scroll offset. The roost foot anchor is at 22.5% of width and 76.5% of height, lifting the curled drawing onto the cushion instead of the front stone rim. These are chosen interface landmarks, not AI detection of objects in the picture.

title.ja: ゆきの居場所を覚える

explanation: YukiLocation stores one position, pose and travel record in the visitor's sessionStorage. English and Japanese versions share a canonical page path. A cross-page call keeps its origin, target, start time and two travel legs; revisiting the origin during departure resumes that journey and lets the visitor stop her. Unloaded pages use elapsed timing, not background rendering. Ordinary navigation does not send her back to the nest. After inactivity she sleeps, then starts returning home after 45 more seconds. beginHomeReturn retains the origin and marks the transfer as a homecoming. An open garden plays the header entrance, flight to the cushion, landing and bedtime; the status remains returning during travel. An entirely off-page completed return settles into sleep. This is same-browser-tab state, not server or cross-device memory.

title.ja: 途中で呼び止められる飛行

explanation: summonTiming adds waking, takeoff and distance-based departure time. callFlightDuration sets a bounded travel time from real current feet to the chosen destination. catchInFlight stops movement at the visible feet position and keeps existing flapping artwork in a hover, rather than replacing it with a grounded pose or resizing the drawing. A decorative magical sparkle burst appears only at the origin section's header link; it does not attach to Yuki.

title.ja: 引き伸ばさずに画面を満たす

explanation: gardenCamera uses width=max(viewport width, viewport height times 1.5 times 1.12), height=width/1.5 to preserve the 1536:1024 picture ratio while leaving vertical exploration room on tall screens. Translation is clamped to avoid empty edges. The same moving scene extends behind the shared translucent header, rather than using a separate background copy. By default the camera follows the current normalized location; the renderer remaps the character and route by the same scene change. Visitors can pan with the wheel, touch, keyboard or left/right edge buttons, including during a summon. Manual exploration stays in place until a new garden destination is selected. No extra follow toolbar is shown. The image is cropped when necessary, not distorted.
